ValidationRule.description: Restrict Global Sales Head User Edit on the Global Sales Head Approved Budgets
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Profile.Name = "Leadership", NOT(ISNEW()), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Sales", OR( AND(ISCHANGED(Status__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"2nd Level Approved")), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c),"1st Level Approved") ), AND( NOT(ISCHANGED(Status__c)), ISPICKVAL(Status__c,"1st Level Approved") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have necessary permissions to edit the Budget.
